Based on gpui-component 0.8.0 (Apache-2.0). Local change: optional primary click handler for submenu rows, used to select a provider default account while preserving hover and keyboard submenu navigation. Menu rows use the app's 28 pt height, theme text size, 14 pt icons, an 8 pt icon gap and a 1 pt divider so vendored and app-built menu rows match. Error notifications use the same alert mark as the app's failed status. Notification icons sit 2 pt higher so they centre on the first text line.

Motion and surfaces: popovers fade in over 180 ms while rising 4 pt and, when controlled, fade out over 120 ms in place without taking input (`Popover::motion`, `Popover::exit_motion`); menus lift 4 pt as they fade in. Closed dialogs and their backdrop fade out over 140 ms after focus has already returned (`DIALOG_EXIT`); the default entrance is FadeSlide. Toasts enter over 200 ms (ease-out, 16 pt travel) and exit over 150 ms. Tooltip text is 12/11 pt at the theme scale and switching slides over 140 ms ease-out. Spinners turn linearly, phase-locked (`SPINNER_PERIOD`, 800 ms), and show a static dot under Reduce Motion. Shimmers default to a shared 1600 ms `SHIMMER_PERIOD`. Scrollbars appear and expand over 140 ms. Floating surfaces use a 10 pt radius (`popover_radius`). The focus ring is a 1.5 pt line inside the element's edge, and a checkbox draws it on its box.
